title: Cinnamon Rolls

items.item: crescent roll dough sheet (not regular crescent rolls)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Roll out the crescent roll sheet onto a clean kitchen work surface. Brush it with the melted butter.
In a small bowl, mix together the sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over the dough (yes, it's a lot. Yes, use it all).
The crescent roll sheet is a rectangle, with the shorter side facing you, roll it up tightly into a roll. Slice into 6 even pieces with a serrated knife.
Grease six sections of a muffin tin well with cooking spray or more butter. Place each of the rolls cut side up into each section.
Bake for 11-15 minutes or until rolls are golden brown. Place muffin tin on a wire rack and let cool.

While the rolls are cooling, place the softened cream cheese in a medium-size bowl and cream until smooth with a hand mixer. Add the powdered sugar and vanilla, and mix to combine. Add the butter and mix to combine until smooth. Add the milk one tablespoon at a time until desired consistency. The glaze should be thick but pourable.
Take the rolls out of the muffin tin, glaze rolls, serve while still warm.
notes: Makes 6 rolls, baked in a muffin tin. Doc shows reduced quantities in parentheses.
